results.title: 18-year-old son jumps off a cliff after parents refused to buy him an iPhone; father and mother die trying to save him
results.description: An 18-year-old jumped off a cliff in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar after his parents refused to buy him an iPhone. His father tried to catch him and fell too, while his mother jumped moments later in grief. All three died despite nearly three hours of rescue efforts by police, villagers and fire brigade teams.

results.title: Bitcoin nears $80,000 in its biggest weekly rally in 3 years
results.description: Bitcoin surged toward $80,000 on Saturday, gaining 24.5% over the past week and heading for its strongest weekly rally in more than three years. The rally was supported by lower long-term US bond yields, increased risk appetite, short-position liquidations and renewed institutional buying.
